## 同花顺社区动态 · 9 items

China’s largest retail trading platform, Hithink RoyalFlush (同花顺), suffered a major outage on Friday morning, causing widespread disruption among retail investors and quickly trending on Chinese social media. The company confirmed the issue was resolved but did not disclose the root cause. Separately, the National Development and Reform Commission released the '15th Five-Year Plan for Circular Economy,' and the official 同花顺 account reported business meetings involving Zhenhua Heavy Industries.

- [“同花顺崩了”登上热搜，回应来了](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_) — the platform went down for about 30 minutes during the morning session, preventing millions of users from trading; the stock (300033) nevertheless saw net capital inflows of ¥2.59 billion on the day.
